newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia buys 100,000 tonnes soft wheat.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia buys 100,000 tonnes soft wheat.

text.p: Tunisia bought 100,000 tonnes of Argentine and optional soft wheat for January-February shipment at a tender on Thursday, traders said.
- One lot of 25,000 tonnes of Argentine origin at $130.78 FOB per tonne for January 5-15 shipment.
- One lot of 25,000 tonnes of US, Argentine or EU origin at $152.83 C&F per tonne for shipment on January 15-25.
- One lot of 25,000 tonnes of U.S., Argentine, EU, or Australian origin for February 1-10 shipment.
The February 1-10 shipment wheat was priced at $148.97 per tonne C&F.
- One lot of 25,000 tonnes of U.S., Argentine, EU or Australian origin at $146.97 per tonne C&F for Feb 15-25 shipment.
Argentine traders also reported the Tunisian purchases, giving prices at $155 and $153 CIF for the January shipment wheat and and $149 and $147 CIF for the February dates.
